findings.gap: Candidate verification uses different path bases for ls-tree and git show without requiring --root to be the Git worktree root. From a repository subdirectory, ls-tree resolves the selected path beneath that subdirectory, while commit:path in git show resolves it from the repository root.
findings.risk: If both locations contain the same relative filename, verification can accept the digest of the parent repository's file despite having checked the subproject file's mode. Consent coverage can therefore describe bytes outside the approved physical project; otherwise valid nested-project requests fail.

findings.gap: The advertised read-only plan/check commands call readState(), whose resolver can change existing directory permissions even with create=false. resolveOnboardingPrivateState calls chmodSync when existing private directories are not mode 0700.
findings.risk: Inspecting an existing checkout with mode-0755 private directories changes both directory levels to 0700. A read-only host refuses those writes, preventing the promised read-only consent inspection. The mocked resolver reproduced both chmod requests.
